name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
funding: Japan's government pays tuition, ¥144,000 a month in a master's course or ¥145,000 in a doctoral course, and the flight to Japan, through the Japanese embassy in your country.
deadline: Through your Japanese embassy, most rounds close in May–June (the 2027 round has closed; the 2028 round opens around April 2027)
